intelligence.essence: The eye's first bridge attempt returned "no nav" — the footer strip had not rendered within a 2500ms wait after the "I agree" tap. That was the wait, not the page: the re-run waited for the selector (it arrived at 3.4 s) and all 12 links proved reachable. The checker hit the same class of wait on its first staged leg. When a probe times out, lengthen the wait before calling it a page failure.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you knocked on a door, sweetheart, and nobody answered in three seconds — so you said nobody was home! But they were just walking slowly to the door, sweetheart — they opened it one second later! So we wait a little longer, sweetheart, before we say nobody is home!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the eye tapped "I agree" and waited two and a half seconds for the little footer to appear, dear, and it hadn't appeared yet, so the first try said it didn't work. But the page was just slow, love — one more second and there it was, all twelve links working fine. So when something doesn't show up right away, dear, we wait for it properly before we say it's broken.
